items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I played with Kencan Henry, Frank, Little Cotton Club, jobs, casuals, in Los Angeles and San Francisco.

ctx.x: Johnny was the leader on sax, Kenny Prince on piano, Les Hite, sax, Lionel Hampton, drums, myself on trumpet and a banjo player, I don't remember his name.
I stayed with Johnny until May, 1926. I played with Kencan Henry, Frank, Little Cotton Club, jobs, casuals, in Los Angeles and San Francisco.
